LanguageData.VV_Alert_ApocryphaChannelingDesc: Asphodel is draining the everflower's mana ({PROGRESS}, {TIMELEFT} remaining). \nIf she drains all of it, the bloom ritual fails.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_ApocryphaUnbound: The last of the bound fairy vivis have been freed. Having lost all reason and transformed into a titanic hornet, Asphodel charges toward the everflower. Lay the empress bound to the past to rest, and usher in a new era. \nThe ancient eltex needles wielded by Asphodel have lodged in the ground. They can be reactivated and fired. Though dangerous to handle, they can deal heavy damage and incapacitate Asphodel if they hit her.
LanguageData.VV_Message_ApocryphaBondReleased: A large number of fairy vivis bound to Asphodel have been freed.
LanguageData.VV_Message_ApocryphaChannelInterrupted: Asphodel's usurpation of the everflower was interrupted.
LanguageData.VV_Message_ApocryphaEscapedRoofCollapse: Asphodel teleported away from a roof collapse.
LanguageData.VV_Message_ApocryphaShieldBroken: Asphodel's mana shield has shattered, stunning her.
LanguageData.VV_Message_ApocryphaShieldRestored: Asphodel's mana shield has been restored.
LanguageData.VV_Message_ApocryphaNeedleStuck: An ancient needle lodged in Asphodel's carapace, briefly stunning her.
LanguageData.VV_Message_ApocryphaAllNeedlesStuck: All the ancient needles have lodged in Asphodel, stunning her.
LanguageData.VV_Message_ApocryphaNeedlesPulled: Asphodel tore the lodged needles out and scattered them across the ground.
LanguageData.VV_Message_ApocryphaNeedleActivated: An ancient needle activates and aims at {PAWN_labelShort}.
